meta.title: DeepSeek Web window
meta.description: Adds a DeepSeek Web row above the sidebar balance. It opens the real chat.deepseek.com in a compact window above that row, as wide as the sidebar and resizable from its right edge: the user's own account, browser usage limits, no API tokens, nothing added around the page beyond a reload, open-in-browser and close header. The embedded window exists only in the Desktop app; a browser-only Harness opens the site in a tab instead.
